answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 68336 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to perform Hajj or Umrah on behalf of two or more people in one Hajj or Umrah? Question: Is it permissible to perform Hajj or Umrah on behalf of two or more people in one Hajj or Umrah? Please quote the reference of the Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 68336 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1250/1262/N=11/1437) If it is Hajj-e-Badal or Umrah-Badal then it may be done only on behalf of one person, not many. And if someone wants to do isal-e-sawab of his/her Hajj or Umrah then he/she may do isal-e-sawab to as many people he/she wishes from his/her Hajj and Umrah. (al-Durr al-Mukhtar & Radd al-Muhtar, Kitab al-Hajj, Bab al-Hajj An al-Ghair, 4: 28-30, pub. Maktaba Zakaria Deoband). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
